column1: # The FPGA-to-HPS bridge (ACE5-Lite, 256-bit) at the fabric: per port bit, the routing-graph node it
# meets. Its ports are the SM_SOC_MPFE atom's F2SOC_* (the MPFE takes fpga2hps_*, then hands it to
# the HPS's CCU): in = the fabric drives it (the RPII sink); out = it drives the fabric (the last
# SOC_MPFE_WRAPPER_RE node of its route). F2SOC_CLK is a global-clock sink. 32 of the 40 address
# bits. From a Quartus 26.1.1 route dump (tools/hps_routes.tcl, HPS_ROUTES_ATOMS='SOC_HPS
# SM_SOC_MPFE', HPS_ROUTES_MATCH='F2SOC_*', the MPFE atom's routes) of designs/hpsf built with
# ENABLE_FPGA2HPS, f2s_data_width 256 and HPSF_BRIDGEMAP, tabled by tools/hps_table.py; the
